propositions: infra/gerrit/materialize-deploy-key.sh is absent from CONFIG_PATHS literal in autodeploy.sh, causing merged changes to the deploy-key materializer to rsync silently without signaling AUTODEPLOY_ERROR

A source change to materialize-deploy-key.sh produces no detection signal while an identical sibling change to materialize-g2p-config.sh (which IS in CONFIG_PATHS) correctly emits AUTODEPLOY_ERROR reason=config_manual
infra/scripts/mcp-entrypoint.sh is baked into the mcp Docker image but absent from MCP_PATHS literal, preventing blue-green mcp deploy automation from triggering on entrypoint source changes

Regression tests must verify that adding materialize-deploy-key.sh to CONFIG_PATHS causes deploy-key-only changes to emit config_manual signal and that adding mcp-entrypoint.sh to MCP_PATHS triggers docker compose build + nginx flip on entrypoint changes
